info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Logistics Shipments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API provides real-time visibility into the status of logistics shipments. Users can retrieve detailed information regarding the current status of their shipments, allowing for better supply chain management and operational planning. This API is essential for logistics managers and companies looking to optimize delivery processes and enhance customer satisfaction. It supports integration with various software solutions, enabling seamless tracking and management of shipments throughout the delivery cycle.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the status of your shipments, providing key details about their current state, estimated delivery time, and any exceptions that may have occurred during transit.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of shipments. This body should contain the necessary parameters in JSON format to effectively query the shipment statuses.

200.description: Request completed successfully and shipment status retrieved.
